name: Improve Neural Gateway
description: Evidence-driven optimization of token cost, prompt caching, loop guards, and model routing.

steps.title: Analyze cost and performance
steps.description: Read mission_total and llm_usage telemetry. Calculate: cost per mission by organ, cache hit rate, loop-guard termination rate, model error rate. Compare against targets.
steps.accept_criteria: Metrics calculated and compared against targets (cache >50%, terminations <5%, errors <1%).

steps.title: Implement optimization
steps.description: Adjust cache breakpoint, loop-guard thresholds (in contracts.json), or model routing based on analysis. Commit change.

steps.title: Measure impact
steps.description: Deploy. Run 5 comparable missions. Compare before/after on target metrics.
